result.reason: The added language satisfies the fallback and substantially reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months’ fees or USD 1,000,000, mutually excludes indirect/consequential damages, includes all fallback carve-outs plus data protection, fraud, and IP infringement, and excludes Customer payment obligations from the cap. It does not expressly carve out security obligations, so it falls short of the full preferred position. The change is otherwise targeted and preserves the warranty language, though placing the provision within Section 9(a) and the slightly awkward Excluded Claims definition reduce drafting quality.
